digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS is not refreshed on redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, preserving divergent history across redeployments.
The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block but the script does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent clones, leaving no convergence mechanism.
The autodeploy script omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing scripts-only changes to that file from triggering deployment.
A store write failure after Gerrit vote cast must not undo the vote; convergence failure must remain best-effort and never wedge an already-cast vote.
The ensure script must use explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets to advance the remote-tracking ref that the classifier reads.

A pre-epoch local clone whose pre-fetch tip is an ancestor of the readable prior remote tip must adopt the pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing commit; all diverged/ahead/corrupt/missing states must refuse adoption and preserve the exact local tip with operator warning.
